cohort: 1793 women undergoing IVF/ICSI who had a previous delivery between January 2015 and December 2016
finding: Women undergoing IVF/ICSI with a previous Caesarean section had a lower live birth rate and a higher miscarriage rate compared to those with a previous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that women undergoing IVF/ICSI who had a previous cesarean section had a lower live birth rate and a higher miscarriage rate than those with a previous vaginal delivery.
